name: system-architect
description: Design evidence-grounded architecture and connect modules, local files, explicit experiment history, and storage in shareable offline workspaces.

interface.shortDescription: Connect architecture, files, experiment history, and storage.
interface.longDescription: Design low-complexity modules and interfaces, validate ownership, render editable architecture views, and build offline file/history workspaces from read-only directory scans and explicit experiment receipts.
defaultPrompt: Use $system-architect to turn these approved requirements and primary evidence into low-complexity architecture options and trade-offs.
Use $architecture-visualizer to render this architecture as interactive HTML and SVG.
Check whether this diff crosses a registered module boundary.
Use $architecture-workspace to connect this project's modules, directory snapshots, and explicit experiment records in an offline reader.
